facts.text: The platform uses a programmable EA-PS 10060-170 source rated 0-60 V, 0-170 A and 5 kW
The source connects over USB as a virtual COM port and SCPIController sends SCPI ASCII commands
The electrical limits come from the EA-PS 10000 3U manual, document 06230820_EN
V_MAX is 60.0 V, I_MAX 170.0 A, P_MAX 5000.0 W and DT_MIN 200 ms
EAPowerSupply is the low-latency SCPI driver the upstream bridge uses for the source
V and I setpoints are not queried from the source; the upstream caches them when it sends commands
read_meas_fast returns measured V, I and P, using MEAS:ALL? or the separate MEAS:VOLT? and MEAS:CURR? queries
get_output_state queries OUTP:STAT? and treats the reply '1' or 'ON' as output on
get_error_code queries SYST:ERR? and reads the first field as an integer
output(on) writes OUTP ON or OUTP OFF and caches the resulting state
set_voltage writes VOLT after clamping the value to 0.0 through V_MAX and caches it as cached_vset
set_current_limit writes CURR after clamping the value to 0.0 through I_MAX and caches it as cached_iset
SCPIController.stop() clears the running flag and calls output_off(), which sends OUTP OFF
STAT:OPER:COND? bit 6 (0x0040) means the output is active and bit 9 (0x0200) means remote control is active
